name: Flatnis Lailaps
original_name: フラトニス・ライラプス
source:
"No doubt you came to this world as a mighty saintess to meet me!"

A knight from the rival nation of Regenerate, ranked among the very strongest.

He prefers straightforward expressions of emotion and has little patience for anything indirect.

After challenging the heroine to a head-to-head duel, he was instantly captivated by her beauty and strength—and has since pursued her with relentless determination.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
